packageRules.description: Minor and patch grouped into one PR. These are the bumps that clear CVEs, and reviewing them one image at a time is how a backlog like this stops getting reviewed at all.
Majors stay separate and each needs a tick on the dependency dashboard before a PR is even opened. A major Postgres or Caddy bump is a migration and a config review, not a dependency update.
Postgres holds production data for every household app. Never grouped with anything else, so its diff is always read on its own.
